_comment: Colab-tractable Stage 1 config. Original heavy targets (N=2000 M=200 T=2000 nSweeps=5) projected to ~45 h on Colab single-CPU. Shrunk so 30 reps x 3 seeds = 90 SMC fits finish in roughly one ~12 h Colab session, with progress visible per anneal step (smc.verbose=true). The §4.5 acceptance criteria (coverage>=0.90, Rhat<=1.10, MCSE<=0.50, sign-flip<0.05) are still in play at these sizes.
